description: This file is a script that performs architecture smell detection on a TypeScript-based codebase, analyzing source files to identify specific code patterns and structural issues related to plugin SDKs and runtime types.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Function to compare two inventory entries for sorting based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Function to add an entry to the list of detected architecture issues.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Scans a source file for plugin SDK extension facade re-exports that might indicate architecture smells.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Detects direct references to runtime implementation types from a source file.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Analyzes source files for patterns related to runtime service locator and mutable state practices that could be problematic.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Main function to collect all architecture smell entries from the source codebase.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collected architecture smell entries into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Runs the architecture smell detection and outputs results in JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the architecture smell check process.
